convert_jax_checkpoint_to_diffusers_pipe: run the script to convert a JAX music spectrogram diffusion checkpoint to a diffusers SpectrogramDiffusionPipeline
load_notes_encoder_weights: load JAX checkpoint weights into a SpectrogramNotesEncoder model for music token encoding
load_continuous_encoder_weights: load JAX checkpoint weights into a SpectrogramContEncoder model for continuous audio feature encoding
load_decoder_weights: load JAX checkpoint weights into a T5FilmDecoder model for spectrogram diffusion decoding
save_spectrogram_diffusion_pipeline: save a converted SpectrogramDiffusionPipeline with DDPMScheduler and melgan vocoder to a given output path
